comment.body: Thanks for the report. The public evidence only shows that hotkeys broadly stop working on v0.100.2 / Windows 11 Pro 24H2, and the attached archive does not isolate which component is failing. Please reproduce this on a supported current PowerToys version, then comment `/bugreport` immediately after the failure. Include the PowerToys version, Windows version, and a short numbered description of the expected and actual result.
